Container.Name: Dirflux
Container.Overview: Dirflux is a self-hosted file manager with two panes, uploads, previews, editing and share links. Beta release. Set the initial administrator password during installation, then sign in as admin. Protect remote access with HTTPS.
Container.Requires: Use separate Files and Appdata folders. Empty mount roots are initialized automatically; existing files and permissions are preserved.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: HTTP port. Use an HTTPS proxy for remote access.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: Only this folder is exposed through the file manager. Keep it outside Appdata.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private accounts, sessions, settings and trash. Never place inside Files.

Config.Name: Initial administrator password
Config.Description: Choose 12–1024 characters. Used only when no account exists; never resets an existing password.

Config.Name: Read only
Config.Description: Set true to disable file mutations.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set true only when accessing through HTTPS.
